verses.iast: tryakṣarī, divyagandhāḍhyā, sindhūra tilakāñchitā । umā, śailēndratanayā, gaurī, gandharva sēvitā ॥ 126 ॥
verses.meaning: Of three syllables; rich with divine fragrance; adorned with a vermilion tilaka; Uma; daughter of the king of mountains; the fair one (Gauri); served by the Gandharvas.

verses.devanagari: विश्वगर्भा स्वर्णगर्भाऽवरदा वागधीश्वरी । ध्यानगम्याऽपरिच्छेद्या ज्ञानदा ज्ञानविग्रहा ॥ १२७ ॥
verses.iast: viśvagarbhā, svarṇagarbhā,'varadā vāgadhīśvarī । dhyānagamyā,'parichChēdyā, jñānadā, jñānavigrahā ॥ 127 ॥
verses.meaning: Who holds the universe in her womb; the golden womb (Hiranyagarbha); slayer of demons (Avarada); ruler of speech; Reached through meditation; beyond all limits; giver of knowledge; embodiment of knowledge.

verses.devanagari: सर्ववेदान्त संवेद्या सत्यानन्द स्वरूपिणी । लोपामुद्रार्चिता लीलाकॢप्त ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ १२८ ॥
verses.iast: sarvavēdānta saṃvēdyā, satyānanda svarūpiṇī । lōpāmudrārchitā, līlākḷpta brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā ॥ 128 ॥
verses.meaning: Known through all of Vedanta; whose nature is truth and bliss; Worshipped by Lopamudra; who creates the universes as play.

verses.devanagari: अद्ड़्श्या द्ड़्श्यरहिता विज्ञात्री वेद्यवर्जिता । योगिनी योगदा योग्या योगानन्दा युगन्धरा ॥ १२९ ॥
verses.iast: adṛśyā, dṛśyarahitā, vijñātrī, vēdyavarjitā । yōginī, yōgadā, yōgyā, yōgānandā, yugandharā ॥ 129 ॥
verses.meaning: Invisible; with nothing else to be seen; the knower; with nothing else to be known; The Yogini; giver of yoga; the fit goal of yoga; the bliss of yoga; upholder of the ages.

verses.devanagari: इच्छाशक्ति ज्ञानशक्ति क्रियाशक्ति स्वरूपिणी । सर्वाधारा सुप्रतिष्ठा सदसद्रूपधारिणी ॥ १३० ॥
verses.iast: ichChāśakti jñānaśakti kriyāśakti svarūpiṇī । sarvādhārā, supratiṣṭhā, sadasad-rūpadhāriṇī ॥ 130 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is the powers of will, knowledge and action; The support of all; firmly established; who takes the forms of both the real and the unreal.

verses.devanagari: अष्टमूर्ति रजाजैत्री लोकयात्रा विधायिनी । एकाकिनी भूमरूपा निर्द्वैता द्वैतवर्जिता ॥ १३१ ॥
verses.iast: aṣṭamūrti, rajājaitrī, lōkayātrā vidhāyinī । ēkākinī, bhūmarūpā, nirdvaitā, dvaitavarjitā ॥ 131 ॥
verses.meaning: Of eight forms; conqueror of ignorance; who carries on the affairs of the world; The solitary one; of the form of the whole (Bhuma); non-dual; beyond duality.

verses.devanagari: अन्नदा वसुदा व्ड़्द्धा ब्रह्मात्मैक्य स्वरूपिणी । ब्ढ़ती ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मानन्दा बलिप्रिया ॥ १३२ ॥
verses.iast: annadā, vasudā, vṛddhā, brahmātmaikya svarūpiṇī । bṛhatī, brāhmaṇī, brāhmī, brahmānandā, balipriyā ॥ 132 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of food; giver of wealth; the ancient one; whose nature is the oneness of Brahman and the Self; The vast one (Brihati); Brahmani; Brahmi (Sarasvati); the bliss of Brahman; fond of offerings (bali).

verses.devanagari: भाषारूपा ब्ढ़त्सेना भावाभाव विवर्जिता । सुखाराध्या शुभकरी शोभना सुलभागतिः ॥ १३३ ॥
verses.iast: bhāṣārūpā, bṛhatsēnā, bhāvābhāva vivarjitā । sukhārādhyā, śubhakarī, śōbhanā sulabhāgatiḥ ॥ 133 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is language; with a vast army; beyond existence and non-existence; Easily worshipped; doer of good; radiant; the easily reached goal.

verses.devanagari: राजराजेश्वरी राज्यदायिनी राज्यवल्लभा । राजत्क्ड़्पा राजपीठ निवेशित निजाश्रिताः ॥ १३४ ॥
verses.iast: rājarājēśvarī, rājyadāyinī, rājyavallabhā । rājat-kṛpā, rājapīṭha nivēśita nijāśritāḥ ॥ 134 ॥
verses.meaning: Rajarajeshvari (queen of the king of kings); giver of kingdoms; beloved of kingdoms; Whose grace shines; who seats those who take refuge in her on royal thrones.

verses.devanagari: राज्यलक्ष्मीः कोशनाथा चतुरङ्ग बलेश्वरी । साम्राज्यदायिनी सत्यसन्धा सागरमेखला ॥ १३५ ॥
verses.iast: rājyalakṣmīḥ, kōśanāthā, chaturaṅga balēśvarī । sāmrājyadāyinī, satyasandhā, sāgaramēkhalā ॥ 135 ॥
verses.meaning: The fortune (Lakshmi) of the kingdom; mistress of the treasury; commander of the four-fold army; Giver of empires; true to her word; whose girdle is the ocean (the earth).

verses.devanagari: दीक्षिता दैत्यशमनी सर्वलोक वशङ्करी । सर्वार्थदात्री सावित्री सच्चिदानन्द रूपिणी ॥ १३६ ॥
verses.iast: dīkṣitā, daityaśamanī, sarvalōka vaśaṅkarī । sarvārthadātrī, sāvitrī, sachchidānanda rūpiṇī ॥ 136 ॥
verses.meaning: Consecrated (Dikshita); queller of demons; who brings all the worlds under her sway; Giver of all desires; Savitri; whose form is Sat-Chit-Ananda (being, consciousness and bliss).

verses.devanagari: देशकालाऽपरिच्छिन्ना सर्वगा सर्वमोहिनी । सरस्वती शास्त्रमयी गुहाम्बा गुह्यरूपिणी ॥ १३७ ॥
verses.iast: dēśakālā'parichChinnā, sarvagā, sarvamōhinī । sarasvatī, śāstramayī, guhāmbā, guhyarūpiṇī ॥ 137 ॥
verses.meaning: Unlimited by space and time; all-pervading; who enchants all; Sarasvati; embodiment of the scriptures; mother of Guha; whose form is secret.

verses.devanagari: सर्वोपाधि विनिर्मुक्ता सदाशिव पतिव्रता । सम्प्रदायेश्वरी साध्वी गुरुमण्डल रूपिणी ॥ १३८ ॥
verses.iast: sarvōpādhi vinirmuktā, sadāśiva pativratā । sampradāyēśvarī, sādhvī, gurumaṇḍala rūpiṇī ॥ 138 ॥
verses.meaning: Free from all limiting conditions; devoted wife of Sadashiva; Ruler of the traditions (sampradaya); the virtuous one; whose form is the circle of Gurus.

verses.devanagari: कुलोत्तीर्णा भगाराध्या माया मधुमती मही । गणाम्बा गुह्यकाराध्या कोमलाङ्गी गुरुप्रिया ॥ १३९ ॥
verses.iast: kulōttīrṇā, bhagārādhyā, māyā, madhumatī, mahī । gaṇāmbā, guhyakārādhyā, kōmalāṅgī, gurupriyā ॥ 139 ॥
verses.meaning: Beyond Kula; worshipped in the disc of the sun (Bhaga); Maya; sweet as honey (Madhumati); the Earth; Mother of the Ganas; worshipped by the Guhyakas; tender-limbed; beloved of the Guru.

verses.devanagari: स्वतन्त्रा सर्वतन्त्रेशी दक्षिणामूर्ति रूपिणी । सनकादि समाराध्या शिवज्ञान प्रदायिनी ॥ १४० ॥
verses.iast: svatantrā, sarvatantrēśī, dakṣiṇāmūrti rūpiṇī । sanakādi samārādhyā, śivajñāna pradāyinī ॥ 140 ॥
verses.meaning: Independent; ruler of all tantras; whose form is Dakshinamurti; Worshipped by Sanaka and the other sages; giver of the knowledge of Shiva.

verses.devanagari: चित्कळाऽनन्दकलिका प्रेमरूपा प्रियङ्करी । नामपारायण प्रीता नन्दिविद्या नटेश्वरी ॥ १४१ ॥
verses.iast: chitkaḻā,'nandakalikā, prēmarūpā, priyaṅkarī । nāmapārāyaṇa prītā, nandividyā, naṭēśvarī ॥ 141 ॥
verses.meaning: The spark (kala) of consciousness; the bud of bliss; embodiment of love; who does what is pleasing; Pleased by the recitation of her names; the Nandi-vidya; ruler of dancers (consort of Nataraja).

verses.devanagari: मिथ्या जगदधिष्ठाना मुक्तिदा मुक्तिरूपिणी । लास्यप्रिया लयकरी लज्जा रम्भादि वन्दिता ॥ १४२ ॥
verses.iast: mithyā jagadadhiṣṭhānā muktidā, muktirūpiṇī । lāsyapriyā, layakarī, lajjā, rambhādi vanditā ॥ 142 ॥
verses.meaning: The ground on which the illusory world rests; giver of liberation; embodiment of liberation; Fond of the lasya dance; cause of dissolution; modesty; adored by Rambha and the other celestial dancers.

verses.devanagari: भवदाव सुधाव्ड़्ष्टिः पापारण्य दवानला । दौर्भाग्यतूल वातूला जराध्वान्त रविप्रभा ॥ १४३ ॥
verses.iast: bhavadāva sudhāvṛṣṭiḥ, pāpāraṇya davānalā । daurbhāgyatūla vātūlā, jarādhvānta raviprabhā ॥ 143 ॥
verses.meaning: A rain of nectar on the forest fire of worldly existence; a wildfire to the forest of sins; A whirlwind that scatters the cotton of misfortune; sunlight that dispels the darkness of old age.

verses.devanagari: भाग्याब्धिचन्द्रिका भक्तचित्तकेकि घनाघना । रोगपर्वत दम्भोळि र्म्ड़्त्युदारु कुठारिका ॥ १४४ ॥
verses.iast: bhāgyābdhichandrikā, bhaktachittakēki ghanāghanā । rōgaparvata dambhōḻi, rmṛtyudāru kuṭhārikā ॥ 144 ॥
verses.meaning: Moonlight on the ocean of good fortune; a rain-cloud to the peacock-like minds of devotees; A thunderbolt to the mountain of disease; an axe to the tree of death.

verses.devanagari: महेश्वरी महाकाळी महाग्रासा महाऽशना । अपर्णा चण्डिका चण्डमुण्डाऽसुर निषूदिनी ॥ १४५ ॥
verses.iast: mahēśvarī, mahākāḻī, mahāgrāsā, mahā'śanā । aparṇā, chaṇḍikā, chaṇḍamuṇḍā'sura niṣūdinī ॥ 145 ॥
verses.meaning: The great ruler (Maheshvari); Mahakali; the great devourer; the great consumer of all; Aparna (who did not even eat leaves in her penance); Chandika; slayer of the demons Chanda and Munda.

verses.devanagari: क्षराक्षरात्मिका सर्वलोकेशी विश्वधारिणी । त्रिवर्गदात्री सुभगा त्र्यम्बका त्रिगुणात्मिका ॥ १४६ ॥
verses.iast: kṣarākṣarātmikā, sarvalōkēśī, viśvadhāriṇī । trivargadātrī, subhagā, tryambakā, triguṇātmikā ॥ 146 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose nature is both the perishable and the imperishable; ruler of all worlds; supporter of the universe; Giver of the three goals of life; the graceful one; the three-eyed; embodiment of the three gunas.

verses.devanagari: स्वर्गापवर्गदा शुद्धा जपापुष्प निभाक्ड़्तिः । ओजोवती द्युतिधरा यज्ञरूपा प्रियव्रता ॥ १४७ ॥
verses.iast: svargāpavargadā, śuddhā, japāpuṣpa nibhākṛtiḥ । ōjōvatī, dyutidharā, yajñarūpā, priyavratā ॥ 147 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of heaven and liberation; pure; radiant like the hibiscus flower; Full of vitality (ojas); bearer of light; whose form is sacrifice; fond of sacred vows.

verses.devanagari: दुराराध्या दुरादर्षा पाटली कुसुमप्रिया । महती मेरुनिलया मन्दार कुसुमप्रिया ॥ १४८ ॥
verses.iast: durārādhyā, durādarṣā, pāṭalī kusumapriyā । mahatī, mērunilayā, mandāra kusumapriyā ॥ 148 ॥
verses.meaning: Hard to worship; hard to overpower; fond of patali flowers; The great one (Mahati); dwelling on Mount Meru; fond of mandara flowers.

verses.devanagari: वीराराध्या विराड्रूपा विरजा विश्वतोमुखी । प्रत्यग्रूपा पराकाशा प्राणदा प्राणरूपिणी ॥ १४९ ॥
verses.iast: vīrārādhyā, virāḍrūpā, virajā, viśvatōmukhī । pratyagrūpā, parākāśā, prāṇadā, prāṇarūpiṇī ॥ 149 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped by heroes; whose form is the cosmos (Virat); pure (free of rajas); facing all sides; Whose form is the inner Self; the supreme space; giver of life; whose form is life.

verses.devanagari: मार्ताण्ड भैरवाराध्या मन्त्रिणी न्यस्तराज्यधूः । त्रिपुरेशी जयत्सेना निस्त्रैगुण्या परापरा ॥ १५० ॥
verses.iast: mārtāṇḍa bhairavārādhyā, mantriṇī nyastarājyadhūḥ । tripurēśī, jayatsēnā, nistraiguṇyā, parāparā ॥ 150 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped by Martanda Bhairava; who entrusted the burdens of rule to Mantrini; Ruler of Tripura; with a victorious army; beyond the three gunas; both supreme and lower.

verses.devanagari: सत्यज्ञानाऽनन्दरूपा सामरस्य परायणा । कपर्दिनी कलामाला कामधुक्कामरूपिणी ॥ १५१ ॥
verses.iast: satyajñānā'nandarūpā, sāmarasya parāyaṇā । kapardinī, kalāmālā, kāmadhuk,kāmarūpiṇī ॥ 151 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is truth, knowledge and bliss; devoted to the state of oneness (samarasya); Consort of Kapardin (Shiva); garlanded with the arts; who yields all desires (Kamadhenu); who takes any form at will.

verses.devanagari: कळानिधिः काव्यकळा रसज्ञा रसशेवधिः । पुष्टा पुरातना पूज्या पुष्करा पुष्करेक्षणा ॥ १५२ ॥
verses.iast: kaḻānidhiḥ, kāvyakaḻā, rasajñā, rasaśēvadhiḥ । puṣṭā, purātanā, pūjyā, puṣkarā, puṣkarēkṣaṇā ॥ 152 ॥
verses.meaning: Treasure of the arts; the art of poetry; knower of rasa (essence); treasury of rasa; Full and nourished; the ancient one; worthy of worship; the nourisher (Pushkara); lotus-eyed.

verses.devanagari: परञ्ज्योतिः परन्धाम परमाणुः परात्परा । पाशहस्ता पाशहन्त्री परमन्त्र विभेदिनी ॥ १५३ ॥
verses.iast: parañjyōtiḥ, parandhāma, paramāṇuḥ, parātparā । pāśahastā, pāśahantrī, paramantra vibhēdinī ॥ 153 ॥
verses.meaning: The supreme light; the supreme abode; the subtlest atom; higher than the highest; Holding the noose in her hand; destroyer of bonds; who breaks the spells of enemies.

verses.devanagari: मूर्ताऽमूर्ताऽनित्यत्ड़्प्ता मुनि मानस हंसिका । सत्यव्रता सत्यरूपा सर्वान्तर्यामिनी सती ॥ १५४ ॥
verses.iast: mūrtā,'mūrtā,'nityatṛptā, muni mānasa haṃsikā । satyavratā, satyarūpā, sarvāntaryāminī, satī ॥ 154 ॥
verses.meaning: With form; formless; pleased even with passing offerings; the swan in the minds of sages; Devoted to truth; whose form is truth; the inner controller of all; Sati.

verses.devanagari: ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मजननी बहुरूपा बुधार्चिता । प्रसवित्री प्रचण्डाऽज्ञा प्रतिष्ठा प्रकटाक्ड़्तिः ॥ १५५ ॥
verses.iast: brahmāṇī, brahmajananī, bahurūpā, budhārchitā । prasavitrī, prachaṇḍā'jñā, pratiṣṭhā, prakaṭākṛtiḥ ॥ 155 ॥
verses.meaning: Brahmani; mother of Brahma; of many forms; worshipped by the wise; Who gives birth to all; the Fierce; the Command (Ajna); the foundation (Pratishtha); manifest in form.

verses.devanagari: प्राणेश्वरी प्राणदात्री पञ्चाशत्पीठरूपिणी । विश्ड़्ङ्खला विविक्तस्था वीरमाता वियत्प्रसूः ॥ १५६ ॥
verses.iast: prāṇēśvarī, prāṇadātrī, pañchāśat-pīṭharūpiṇī । viśṛṅkhalā, viviktasthā, vīramātā, viyatprasūḥ ॥ 156 ॥
verses.meaning: Ruler of the life-breath; giver of life; whose form is the fifty sacred seats (pithas); Unfettered; dwelling in solitude; mother of heroes; mother of space.

verses.devanagari: मुकुन्दा मुक्ति निलया मूलविग्रह रूपिणी । भावज्ञा भवरोगघ्नी भवचक्र प्रवर्तिनी ॥ १५७ ॥
verses.iast: mukundā, mukti nilayā, mūlavigraha rūpiṇī । bhāvajñā, bhavarōgaghnī bhavachakra pravartinī ॥ 157 ॥
verses.meaning: Mukunda (giver of liberation); abode of liberation; whose form is the original image; Knower of all feelings; destroyer of the disease of worldly existence; who turns the wheel of births.

verses.devanagari: छन्दस्सारा शास्त्रसारा मन्त्रसारा तलोदरी । उदारकीर्ति रुद्दामवैभवा वर्णरूपिणी ॥ १५८ ॥
verses.iast: Chandassārā, śāstrasārā, mantrasārā, talōdarī । udārakīrti, ruddāmavaibhavā, varṇarūpiṇī ॥ 158 ॥
verses.meaning: Essence of the Vedic metres; essence of the scriptures; essence of the mantras; slender-waisted; Of noble fame; of boundless glory; whose form is the letters (varnas).

verses.devanagari: जन्मम्ड़्त्यु जरातप्त जन विश्रान्ति दायिनी । सर्वोपनिष दुद्घुष्टा शान्त्यतीत कळात्मिका ॥ १५९ ॥
verses.iast: janmamṛtyu jarātapta jana viśrānti dāyinī । sarvōpaniṣa dudghuṣṭā, śāntyatīta kaḻātmikā ॥ 159 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of rest to people scorched by birth, death and old age; Proclaimed by all the Upanishads; whose nature is the state beyond peace (Shantyatita kala).

verses.devanagari: गम्भीरा गगनान्तःस्था गर्विता गानलोलुपा । कल्पनारहिता काष्ठा कान्ता कान्तार्ध विग्रहा ॥ १६० ॥
verses.iast: gambhīrā, gaganāntaḥsthā, garvitā, gānalōlupā । kalpanārahitā, kāṣṭhā, kāntā, kāntārdha vigrahā ॥ 160 ॥
verses.meaning: Profound; dwelling within space; proud; fond of music; Free of mental constructs; the goal (Kashtha); the beloved; whose body is half of her beloved (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: कार्यकारण निर्मुक्ता कामकेळि तरङ्गिता । कनत्कनकताटङ्का लीलाविग्रह धारिणी ॥ १६१ ॥
verses.iast: kāryakāraṇa nirmuktā, kāmakēḻi taraṅgitā । kanat-kanakatāṭaṅkā, līlāvigraha dhāriṇī ॥ 161 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of cause and effect; rippling with the waves of Kameshvara's love-play; With shining golden earrings; who takes on forms in play.

verses.devanagari: अजाक्षय विनिर्मुक्ता मुग्धा क्षिप्रप्रसादिनी । अन्तर्मुख समाराध्या बहिर्मुख सुदुर्लभा ॥ १६२ ॥
verses.iast: ajākṣaya vinirmuktā, mugdhā kṣipraprasādinī । antarmukha samārādhyā, bahirmukha sudurlabhā ॥ 162 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of birth and decay; the innocent one; quick to grant grace; Worshipped by those who turn inward; very hard to reach for those who turn outward.

verses.devanagari: त्रयी त्रिवर्ग निलया त्रिस्था त्रिपुरमालिनी । निरामया निरालम्बा स्वात्मारामा सुधास्ड़्तिः ॥ १६३ ॥
verses.iast: trayī, trivarga nilayā, tristhā, tripuramālinī । nirāmayā, nirālambā, svātmārāmā, sudhāsṛtiḥ ॥ 163 ॥
verses.meaning: The three Vedas; abode of the three goals of life; dwelling in the three worlds; wearing the garland of Tripura; Free of disease; without support; rejoicing in her own Self; a stream of nectar.

verses.devanagari: संसारपङ्क निर्मग्न समुद्धरण पण्डिता । यज्ञप्रिया यज्ञकर्त्री यजमान स्वरूपिणी ॥ १६४ ॥
verses.iast: saṃsārapaṅka nirmagna samuddharaṇa paṇḍitā । yajñapriyā, yajñakartrī, yajamāna svarūpiṇī ॥ 164 ॥
verses.meaning: Skilled in lifting out those sunk in the mire of worldly existence; Fond of sacrifices; performer of sacrifices; who is herself the one who sacrifices.

verses.devanagari: धर्माधारा धनाध्यक्षा धनधान्य विवर्धिनी । विप्रप्रिया विप्ररूपा विश्वभ्रमण कारिणी ॥ १६५ ॥
verses.iast: dharmādhārā, dhanādhyakṣā, dhanadhānya vivardhinī । viprapriyā, viprarūpā, viśvabhramaṇa kāriṇī ॥ 165 ॥
verses.meaning: Support of dharma; overseer of wealth; increaser of wealth and grain; Fond of the learned; whose form is the learned; who makes the universe revolve.

verses.devanagari: विश्वग्रासा विद्रुमाभा वैष्णवी विष्णुरूपिणी । अयोनि र्योनिनिलया कूटस्था कुलरूपिणी ॥ १६६ ॥
verses.iast: viśvagrāsā, vidrumābhā, vaiṣṇavī, viṣṇurūpiṇī । ayōni, ryōninilayā, kūṭasthā, kularūpiṇī ॥ 166 ॥
verses.meaning: Who devours the universe at dissolution; coral-red in colour; Vaishnavi; whose form is Vishnu; Without origin; dwelling in the source (yoni); unchanging (Kutastha); whose form is Kula.

verses.devanagari: वीरगोष्ठीप्रिया वीरा नैष्कर्म्या नादरूपिणी । विज्ञान कलना कल्या विदग्धा बैन्दवासना ॥ १६७ ॥
verses.iast: vīragōṣṭhīpriyā, vīrā, naiṣkarmyā, nādarūpiṇī । vijñāna kalanā, kalyā vidagdhā, baindavāsanā ॥ 167 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of the assembly of heroes; the heroic one; beyond action; whose form is sound (nada); The working of wisdom; the capable one; the expert; seated in the bindu.

verses.devanagari: तत्त्वाधिका तत्त्वमयी तत्त्वमर्थ स्वरूपिणी । सामगानप्रिया सौम्या सदाशिव कुटुम्बिनी ॥ १६८ ॥
verses.iast: tattvādhikā, tattvamayī, tattvamartha svarūpiṇī । sāmagānapriyā, saumyā, sadāśiva kuṭumbinī ॥ 168 ॥
verses.meaning: Transcending the tattvas; made of the tattvas; whose nature is the meaning of 'Tat Tvam' (That thou art); Fond of Sama Veda chanting; gentle; wife of Sadashiva.

verses.devanagari: सव्यापसव्य मार्गस्था सर्वापद्वि निवारिणी । स्वस्था स्वभावमधुरा धीरा धीर समर्चिता ॥ १६९ ॥
verses.iast: savyāpasavya mārgasthā, sarvāpadvi nivāriṇī । svasthā, svabhāvamadhurā, dhīrā, dhīra samarchitā ॥ 169 ॥
verses.meaning: Who follows both the right and the left paths of worship; who wards off all calamities; Abiding in herself; naturally sweet; courageous; worshipped by the wise.

verses.devanagari: चैतन्यार्घ्य समाराध्या चैतन्य कुसुमप्रिया । सदोदिता सदातुष्टा तरुणादित्य पाटला ॥ १७० ॥
verses.iast: chaitanyārghya samārādhyā, chaitanya kusumapriyā । sadōditā, sadātuṣṭā, taruṇāditya pāṭalā ॥ 170 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped with the offering of consciousness; fond of the flower of consciousness; Ever-rising; ever content; rosy like the rising sun.

verses.devanagari: दक्षिणा दक्षिणाराध्या दरस्मेर मुखाम्बुजा । कौळिनी केवलाऽनर्घ्या कैवल्य पददायिनी ॥ १७१ ॥
verses.iast: dakṣiṇā, dakṣiṇārādhyā, darasmēra mukhāmbujā । kauḻinī kēvalā,'narghyā kaivalya padadāyinī ॥ 171 ॥
verses.meaning: Dakshina (the gracious); worshipped by the learned and the simple alike; with a lotus face lit by a gentle smile; Kaulini; the Absolute (Kevala); priceless; giver of the state of liberation (kaivalya).

verses.devanagari: स्तोत्रप्रिया स्तुतिमती श्रुतिसंस्तुत वैभवा । मनस्विनी मानवती महेशी मङ्गळाक्ड़्तिः ॥ १७२ ॥
verses.iast: stōtrapriyā, stutimatī, śrutisaṃstuta vaibhavā । manasvinī, mānavatī, mahēśī, maṅgaḻākṛtiḥ ॥ 172 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of hymns; worthy of praise; whose glory is praised by the Vedas; Of noble mind; full of dignity; the great ruler; of auspicious form.

verses.devanagari: विश्वमाता जगद्धात्री विशालाक्षी विरागिणी । प्रगल्भा परमोदारा परामोदा मनोमयी ॥ १७३ ॥
verses.iast: viśvamātā, jagaddhātrī, viśālākṣī, virāgiṇī। pragalbhā, paramōdārā, parāmōdā, manōmayī ॥ 173 ॥
verses.meaning: Mother of the universe; sustainer of the world; large-eyed; free of attachment; Bold; supremely generous; supreme joy; whose nature is the mind.

verses.devanagari: व्योमकेशी विमानस्था वज्रिणी वामकेश्वरी । पञ्चयज्ञप्रिया पञ्चप्रेत मञ्चाधिशायिनी ॥ १७४ ॥
verses.iast: vyōmakēśī, vimānasthā, vajriṇī, vāmakēśvarī । pañchayajñapriyā, pañchaprēta mañchādhiśāyinī ॥ 174 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose hair is the sky; dwelling in the celestial chariot; holder of the thunderbolt; consort of Vamakeshvara; Fond of the five daily sacrifices; reclining on the couch made of the five corpses.

verses.devanagari: पञ्चमी पञ्चभूतेशी पञ्च सङ्ख्योपचारिणी । शाश्वती शाश्वतैश्वर्या शर्मदा शम्भुमोहिनी ॥ १७५ ॥
verses.iast: pañchamī, pañchabhūtēśī, pañcha saṅkhyōpachāriṇī । śāśvatī, śāśvataiśvaryā, śarmadā, śambhumōhinī ॥ 175 ॥
verses.meaning: The fifth (Panchami); ruler of the five elements; worshipped with the five offerings; Eternal; of eternal sovereignty; giver of happiness; enchantress of Shambhu (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: धरा धरसुता धन्या धर्मिणी धर्मवर्धिनी । लोकातीता गुणातीता सर्वातीता शमात्मिका ॥ १७६ ॥
verses.iast: dharā, dharasutā, dhanyā, dharmiṇī, dharmavardhinī । lōkātītā, guṇātītā, sarvātītā, śamātmikā ॥ 176 ॥
verses.meaning: The Earth (Dhara); daughter of the mountain; blessed; righteous; increaser of dharma; Beyond the worlds; beyond the gunas; beyond everything; whose nature is peace.

verses.devanagari: बन्धूक कुसुम प्रख्या बाला लीलाविनोदिनी । सुमङ्गळी सुखकरी सुवेषाड्या सुवासिनी ॥ १७७ ॥
verses.iast: bandhūka kusuma prakhyā, bālā, līlāvinōdinī । sumaṅgaḻī, sukhakarī, suvēṣāḍyā, suvāsinī ॥ 177 ॥
verses.meaning: Radiant like the bandhuka flower; the young girl (Bala); who delights in play; Wholly auspicious (Sumangali); giver of happiness; beautifully dressed; the auspicious married woman (Suvasini).

verses.devanagari: सुवासिन्यर्चनप्रीता शोभना शुद्ध मानसा । बिन्दु तर्पण सन्तुष्टा पूर्वजा त्रिपुराम्बिका ॥ १७८ ॥
verses.iast: suvāsinyarchanaprītā, śōbhanā, śuddha mānasā । bindu tarpaṇa santuṣṭā, pūrvajā, tripurāmbikā ॥ 178 ॥
verses.meaning: Pleased by the worship of suvasinis (married women); radiant; pure-minded; Pleased by offerings into the bindu; the first-born; Tripurambika.

verses.devanagari: दशमुद्रा समाराध्या त्रिपुरा श्रीवशङ्करी । ज्ञानमुद्रा ज्ञानगम्या ज्ञानज्ञेय स्वरूपिणी ॥ १७९ ॥
verses.iast: daśamudrā samārādhyā, tripurā śrīvaśaṅkarī । jñānamudrā, jñānagamyā, jñānajñēya svarūpiṇī ॥ 179 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped through the ten mudras; Tripurashri, who brings all under her sway; The jnana-mudra; reached through knowledge; whose form is both knowledge and the known.

verses.devanagari: योनिमुद्रा त्रिखण्डेशी त्रिगुणाम्बा त्रिकोणगा । अनघाद्भुत चारित्रा वाञ्छितार्थ प्रदायिनी ॥ १८० ॥
verses.iast: yōnimudrā, trikhaṇḍēśī, triguṇāmbā, trikōṇagā । anaghādbhuta chāritrā, vāñChitārtha pradāyinī ॥ 180 ॥
verses.meaning: The yoni-mudra; ruler of the three sections (Trikhanda); mother of the three gunas; dwelling in the triangle; Of sinless and wondrous deeds; giver of all that is desired.

verses.devanagari: अभ्यासाति शयज्ञाता षडध्वातीत रूपिणी । अव्याज करुणामूर्ति रज्ञानध्वान्त दीपिका ॥ १८१ ॥
verses.iast: abhyāsāti śayajñātā, ṣaḍadhvātīta rūpiṇī । avyāja karuṇāmūrti, rajñānadhvānta dīpikā ॥ 181 ॥
verses.meaning: Known through intense, repeated practice; whose form transcends the six paths (adhvas); Embodiment of compassion without any motive; the lamp that dispels the darkness of ignorance.

verses.devanagari: आबालगोप विदिता सर्वानुल्लङ्घ्य शासना । श्री चक्रराजनिलया श्रीमत्त्रिपुर सुन्दरी ॥ १८२ ॥
verses.iast: ābālagōpa viditā, sarvānullaṅghya śāsanā । śrī chakrarājanilayā, śrīmattripura sundarī ॥ 182 ॥
verses.meaning: Known to all, even children and cowherds; whose command no one can disobey; Dwelling in the Sri Chakra; the glorious Tripura Sundari.

verses.devanagari: श्री शिवा शिवशक्त्यैक्य रूपिणी ललिताम्बिका । एवं श्रीललितादेव्या नाम्नां साहस्रकं जगुः ॥ १८३ ॥
verses.iast: śrī śivā, śivaśaktyaikya rūpiṇī, lalitāmbikā । ēvaṃ śrīlalitādēvyā nāmnāṃ sāhasrakaṃ jaguḥ ॥ 183 ॥
verses.meaning: Sri Shiva (the Auspicious One); whose form is the union of Shiva and Shakti; Lalitambika (Mother Lalita). Thus did they sing the thousand names of Sri Lalita Devi.

verses.devanagari: ॥ श्री ललिताम्बिकायै नमः ॥

note: A thousand names for the one who pervades everything, each name naming something the same Presence does or is.
overview:
Bhīṣma, lying on the field at the end of the Mahābhārata war, is asked what is the one thing a person should hold to. His answer is this: the thousand names of Viṣṇu, *the one who pervades everything*.

The chant opens with invocation and contemplation, gives the names across a hundred and eight stanzas, and ends with the *phalaśruti* — what the recitation is said to bring. Every one of the thousand names is glossed here on its own, so a stanza can be read name by name rather than as a block of sound.
structure: Four parts — Pūrva Bhāga, Dhyānam, Stotram, Phalaśruti — each broken into groups of ten stanzas of about two minutes, which is as much as most students take on at one sitting.

wordMeanings.meaning: He who pervades everything — the second of the thousand names
the all, or the Universe — the first name of the thousand
the hearing of the fruit — the closing part, on what the recitation brings
the placing — the preparation recited before the names

sections.label: Pūrva Bhāga
sections.note: The opening: invocation, the lineage of the telling, and the nyāsa.

verses.devanagari: शुक्लांबरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् । प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशांतये ॥ १ ॥
verses.iast: śuklāṁbaradharaṁ viṣṇuṁ śaśivarṇaṁ caturbhujam, prasannavadanaṁ dhyāyet sarvavighnōpaśāṁtaye.
verses.meaning: One should meditate on Vishnu, dressed in white robes, moon- coloured, four-armed, with a cheerful face, for the removal of all obstacles.

verses.devanagari: यस्य द्विरदवक्त्राद्याः पारिषद्याः परः शतम् । विघ्नं निघ्नन्ति सततं विष्वकसेनं तमाश्रये ॥ २ ॥
verses.iast: yasya dviradavaktrādyāḥ pāriṣadyāḥ paraḥ śatam, vighnaṁ nighnanti satataṁ viṣvakasenaṁ tamāśraye.
verses.meaning: The elephant faced one, along with his innumerable attendants, would always remove obstacles, as we depend on Vishvaksena.

verses.devanagari: व्यासं वसिष्ठनप्तारं शक्तेः पौत्रमकल्मषम् । पराशरात्मजं वंदे शुकतातं तपोनिधिम् ॥ ३ ॥
verses.iast: vyāsaṁ vasiṣṭhanaptāraṁ śakteḥ pautramakalmaṣam, parāśarātmajaṁ vaṁde śukatātaṁ tapōnidhim.
verses.meaning: I salute Vyasa, the great grandson of Vasishta, the grandson of Shakti, the immaculate son of Parasara, the father of Shukata, the treasure of austerities.

verses.devanagari: व्यासाय विष्णुरूपाय व्यासरूपाय विष्णवे । नमो वै ब्रह्मनिधये वासिष्ठाय नमो नमः ॥ ४ ॥
verses.iast: vyāsāya viṣṇurūpāya vyāsarūpāya viṣṇave, namō vai brahmanidhaye vāsiṣṭhāya namō namaḥ.
verses.meaning: O Vyasa in the form of Vishnu, O Vishnu in the form of Vyasa, O Vasishta, the treasure of the Brahman, I offer my obeisances unto Thee again and again.

verses.devanagari: अविकाराय शुद्धाय नित्याय परमात्मने । सदैकरूपरूपाय विष्णवे सर्वजिष्णवे ॥ ५ ॥
verses.iast: avikārāya śuddhāya nityāya paramātmane, sadaikarūparūpāya viṣṇave sarvajiṣṇave.
verses.meaning: Bow I before Vishnu, Who is pure, Who is not affected, Who is permanent, Who is the ultimate truth, and He who wins over all the mortals in this world.

verses.devanagari: यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण जन्मसंसारबंधनात् । विमुच्यते नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ॥ ६ ॥
verses.iast: yasya smaraṇamātreṇa janmasaṁsārabaṁdhanāt, vimucyate namastasmai viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave.
verses.meaning: Obeisance to that Vishnu, the all-powerful Vishnu, whose remembrance alone frees one from the bondage of birth and death.

verses.devanagari: ॐ नमो विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे । श्री वैशंपायन उवाच । श्रुत्वा धर्मानशेषेण पावनानि च सर्वशः । युधिष्ठिरः शांतनवं पुनरेवाभ्यभ्याषत ॥ ७ ॥
verses.iast: oṃ namo viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave. śrī vaiśaṁpāyana uvāca: śrutvā dharmānaśeṣeṇa pāvanāni ca sarvaśaḥ, yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śāṁtanavaṁ punarevābhyabhyāṣata.
verses.meaning: Sri Vaisampayana said: Having heard the Dharma in its entirety and the holy ones in all respects, Yudhisthira again addressed Shantanu.

verses.devanagari: श्री युधिष्ठिर उवाच । किमेकं दैवतं लोके किं वाप्येकं परायणं । स्तुवंतः कं कमर्चंतः प्राप्नुयुर्मानवाः शुभम् ॥ ८ ॥
verses.iast: śrī yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kimekaṁ daivataṁ lōke kiṁ vāpyekaṁ parāyaṇaṁ, stuvaṁtaḥ kaṁ kamarcaṁtaḥ prāpnuyurmānavāḥ śubham.
verses.meaning: Yudhishthira asked: Is there one god in this world, or is there one devotee? Whom do men attain to good by praising and worshiping?

verses.devanagari: को धर्मः सर्वधर्माणां भवतः परमो मतः । किं जपन्मुच्यते जंतुर्जन्मसंसारबंधनात् ॥ ९ ॥
verses.iast: kō dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṁ bhavataḥ paramō mataḥ, kiṁ japanmucyate jaṁturjanmasaṁsārabaṁdhanāt.
verses.meaning: Which Dharma do you consider to be the supreme of all Dharma? By chanting what is a creature freed from the bondage of birth and death?

verses.devanagari: श्री भीष्म उवाच । जगत्प्रभुं देवदेवमनंतं पुरुषोत्तमम् । स्तुवन्नामसहस्रेण पुरुषः सततोत्थितः ॥ १० ॥
verses.iast: śrī bhīṣma uvāca: jagatprabhuṁ devadevamanaṁtaṁ puruṣōttamam, stuvannāmasahasreṇa puruṣaḥ satatōtthitaḥ.
verses.meaning: Bhishma replied: Praising the Lord of the universe, the God of gods, the infinite Supreme Personality of Godhead, with a thousand names, the man ever rises.

verses.devanagari: तमेव चार्चयन्नित्यं भक्त्या पुरुषमव्ययम् । ध्यायन् स्तुवन्नमस्यंश्च यजमानस्तमेव च ॥ ११ ॥
verses.iast: tameva cārcayannityaṁ bhaktyā puruṣamavyayam, dhyāyan stuvannamasyaṁśca yajamānastameva ca.
verses.meaning: And worshiping Him alone with devotion, meditating on the inexhaustible Purusha, praising and bowing down to Him alone, and offering sacrifices to Him alone, the worshipper, the aspirant (is freed).

verses.devanagari: अनादिनिधनं विष्णुं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । लोकाध्यक्षं स्तुवन्नित्यं सर्वदुःखातिगो भवेत् ॥ १२ ॥
verses.iast: anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram, lokādhyakṣaṃ stuvannityaṃ sarvaduḥkhātigo bhavet.
verses.meaning: By praising Vishnu, the eternally immortal, the great Lord of all the worlds, the presiding deity of the worlds, one can pass beyond all sorrows.

verses.devanagari: ब्रह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं लोकानां कीर्तिवर्धनम् । लोकनाथं महद्भूतं सर्वभूतभवोध्भवम् ॥ १३ ॥
verses.iast: brahmaṇyaṁ sarvadharmajñaṁ lōkānāṁ kīrtivardhanam, lōkanāthaṁ mahadbhūtaṁ sarvabhūtabhavōdhbhavam.
verses.meaning: He is the Brahman, the knower of all religions, the enhancer of the fame of the worlds, the Lord of the worlds, the great being, the origin of all beings.

verses.devanagari: एष मे सर्वधर्माणां धर्मोधिकतमो मतः । यद्भक्त्या पुंडरीकाक्षं स्तवैरर्चेन्नरः सदा ॥ १४ ॥
verses.iast: eṣa me sarvadharmāṇāṁ dharmōdhikatamō mataḥ, yadbhaktyā puṁḍarīkākṣaṁ stavairarcennaraḥ sadā.
verses.meaning: This is the Dharma which I consider to be the highest of all Dharma, that one should always worship the lotus-eyed Lord with devotion and hymns.

verses.devanagari: परमं यो महत्तेजः परमं यो महत्तपः । परमं यो महद्ब्रह्म परमं यः परायणम् ॥ १५ ॥
verses.iast: paramaṁ yō mahattejaḥ paramaṁ yō mahattapaḥ, paramaṁ yō mahadbrahma paramaṁ yaḥ parāyaṇam.
verses.meaning: He is the supreme great light, He is the supreme great ruler. He is the supreme great Brahman (Absolute), He is the supreme highest goal.

verses.devanagari: पवित्राणां पवित्रं यो मंगलानां च मंगलम् । दैवतं दैवतानां च भूतानां योऽव्ययः पित ॥ १६ ॥
verses.iast: pavitrāṇāṁ pavitraṁ yō maṁgalānāṁ ca maṁgalam, daivataṃ daivatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo’vyayaḥ pita.
verses.meaning: He who is holy among the holy and auspicious among the auspicious, who is God among the gods and who is the inexhaustible Father of all beings.

verses.devanagari: यतः सर्वाणि भूतानि भवंत्यादियुगागमे । यस्मिंश्च प्रलयं यांति पुनरेव युगक्षये ॥ १७ ॥
verses.iast: yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhavaṁtyādiyugāgame, yasmiṁśca pralayaṁ yāṁti punareva yugakṣaye.
verses.meaning: From Him all creatures proceed in the beginning of an age, And in Him they are absorbed again at the end of the age.

verses.devanagari: तस्य लोकप्रधानस्य जगन्नाथस्य भूपते । विष्णोर्नामसहस्रं मे श्रुणु पापभयापहम् ॥ १८ ॥
verses.iast: tasya lōkapradhānasya jagannāthasya bhūpate, viṣṇōrnāmasahasraṁ me śruṇu pāpabhayāpaham.
verses.meaning: Of that Chief of the world, of the Lord of the universe, O King (Yudhishthira), Of Vishnu, hear from me the thousand names, which remove all sin and fear.

verses.devanagari: यानि नामानि गौणानि विख्यातानि महात्मनः । ऋषिभिः परिगीतानि तानि वक्ष्यामि भूतये ॥ १९ ॥
verses.iast: yāni nāmāni gauṇāni vikhyātāni mahātmanaḥ, ṛṣibhiḥ parigītāni tāni vakṣyāmi bhūtaye.
verses.meaning: Those famous names of the Great Soul which bring out His manifold qualities celebrated by rishs (seers) I shall declare for the good (of all).

verses.devanagari: ऋषिर्नाम्नां सहस्रस्य वेदव्यासो महामुनिः । छंदोनुष्टुप् तथा देवो भगवान् देवकीसुतः ॥ २० ॥
verses.iast: r̥ṣirnāmnāṁ sahasrasya vedavyāsō mahāmuniḥ, chaṁdōnuṣṭup tathā devō bhagavān devakīsutaḥ.
verses.meaning: The rishi of the thousand names is Vedavyasa, the great contemplative sage; The metre is Anushtup, and the deity is the blessed son of Devaki.

verses.devanagari: अमृतांशूद्भवो बीजं शक्तिर्देवकिनंदन । त्रिसामा हृदयं तस्य शांत्यर्थे विनियुज्यते ॥ २१ ॥
verses.iast: amr̥tāṁśūdbhavō bījaṁ śaktirdevakinaṁdana: trisāmā hr̥dayaṁ tasya śāṁtyarthe viniyujyate.
verses.meaning: The seed is He-who-was-born-in-the-lunar-race; Its power is The Name, The-son-of-Devakī. The heart is the One-who-is-lauded-by-the-three-Sama-hymns, The purpose of its use is the attainment of peace.

verses.devanagari: विष्णुं जिष्णुं महाविष्णुं प्रभविष्णुं महेश्वरम् । अनेकरूप दैत्यांतं नमामि पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥ २२ ॥
verses.iast: viṣṇuṁ jiṣṇuṁ mahāviṣṇuṁ prabhaviṣṇuṁ maheśvaram, anekarūpa daityāṁtaṁ namāmi puruṣōttamam.
verses.meaning: Om; Vishnu, Conqueror, Great Vishnu, Creator, the Great Lord, To Him of many forms, the Destroyer of demons, to the Supreme Person, I bow.

verses.devanagari: पूर्वन्यासः श्रीवेदव्यास उवाच । ॐ अस्य श्री विष्णोर्दिव्यसहस्रनामस्तोत्रमहामंत्रस्य । श्री वेदव्यासो भगवान् ऋषिः । अनुष्टुप् छंदः । श्रीमहाविष्णुः परमात्मा श्रीमन्नारायणो देवता । अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति बीजम् । देवकीनंदनः स्रष्टेति शक्तिः । उध्भवः । क्षोभणो देव इति परमो मंत्रः । शंखभृन्नंदकी चक्रीति कीलकम् । शार्ङ्गधन्वा गदाधर इत्यस्त्रम् । रथांगपाणिरक्षोभ्य इति नेत्रम् । त्रिसामा सामगः सामेति कवचम् । आनंदं परब्रह्मेति योनिः । ऋतुस्सुदर्शन । काल इति दिग्भंधः । श्री विश्वरूप इति ध्यानम् । श्रीमहाविष्णुप्रीत्यर्थे सहस्रनाम पारायणे विनियोगः
verses.iast: pūrvanyāsaḥ śrīvedavyāsa uvāca: oṃ asya śrī viṣṇōrdivyasahasranāmastōtramahāmaṁtrasya, śrī vēdavyāsō bhagavān r̥ṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chaṁdaḥ, śrīmahāviṣṇuḥ paramātmā śrīmannārāyaṇō dēvatā, amr̥tāṁśūdbhavō bhānuriti bījam, dēvakīnaṁdanaḥ sraṣṭēti śaktiḥ, udhbhavaḥ, kṣōbhaṇō dēva iti paramō maṁtraḥ, śaṁkhabhr̥nnaṁdakī cakrīti kīlakam, śārṅgadhanvā gadādhara ityastram, rathāṁgapāṇirakṣōbhya iti nētram, trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāmēti kavacam, ānaṁdaṁ parabrahmēti yōniḥ, r̥tussudarśana: kāla iti digbhaṁdhaḥ, śrī viśvarūpa iti dhyānam, śrīmahāviṣṇuprītyarthē sahasranāma pārāyaṇē viniyōgaḥ.
verses.meaning: Vedavyasa said: Of this garland of mantras (constituting) the praise-song of the divine thousand names of Vishnu, The blessed Vedavyasa is the seer, Krishna, the Supreme Self, is the deity, The metre is Anushtup, "Having His source in the Self, Self-begotten" is the seed, "The son of Devaka, the Creator and Sustainer," is the Power, "He whose glory is sung in the three types of Sama songs; the theme of such songs He who manifests Himself as the Sama Veda" is the heart, "The Bearer of the conch, He of the word, He of the discus" is the nail, "He of the Sharnga bow, the Wielder of the mace" is the weapon, "The One holding the reins of a chariot in His hands (Krishna), who is imperturbable" is the armour, "The source, the vibration, God" is the supreme mantra Let us engage ourselves in the japa of the divine thousand names of Vishnu for the purpose of pleasing Great Vishnu.

sections.label: Dhyānam
sections.note: The verses of contemplation, held in mind before the names begin.

verses.devanagari: क्षीरोदन्वत्प्रदेशे शुचिमणिविलसत्सैकते मौक्तिकानां मालाक्लृप्तासनस्थः स्फटिकमणिनिभैर्मौक्तिकैर्मं डितांगः । शुभ्रैरभ्रैरदभ्रैरुपरिविरचितैर्मुक्तपीयूष वर्षैः आनंदीनः पुनीयादरिनऌइनगदा शंखपाणिर्मुकुंदः ॥ १ ॥
verses.iast: kṣīrōdanvatpradēśē śucimaṇivilasatsaikatē mauktikānāṁ mālāklr̥ptāsanasthaḥ sphaṭikamaṇinibhairmauktikairmaṁ ḍitāṁgaḥ, śubhrairabhrairadabhrairupariviracitairmuktapīyūṣa varṣaiḥ ānaṁdīnaḥ punīyādarinaḷinagadā śaṁkhapāṇirmukuṁdaḥ.
verses.meaning: In the region of the ocean of milk, seated on a garland of pure gems and pearls, adorned with pearls resembling crystal gems, with white clouds, with rains of free nectar, delighting us, may the lotus and mace of the holy mountains, holding a conch, be our joy.

verses.devanagari: भूः पादौ यस्य नाभिर्वियदसुरनिलश्चंद्र सूर्यौ च नेत्रे कर्णावाशाः शिरो द्यौर्मुखमपि दहनो यस्य वासोयमब्धिः । अंतःस्थं यस्य विश्वं सुरनरखगगो भोगिगंधर्वदैत्यैः । चित्रं रं रम्यते तं त्रिभुवनवपुषं विष्णुमीशं नमामि ॥ २ ॥
verses.iast: bhūḥ pādau yasya nābhirviyadasuranilaścaṁdra sūryau ca nētrē karṇāvāśāḥ śirō dyaurmukhamapi dahanō yasya vāsōyamabdhiḥ, aṁtaḥsthaṁ yasya viśvaṁ suranarakhagagō bhōgigaṁdharvadaityaiḥ, citraṁ raṁ ramyatē taṁ tribhuvanavapuṣaṁ viṣṇumīśaṁ namāmi.
verses.meaning: I bow before that God, Vishnu, Who is the lord of three worlds, Who has earth as his feet, Who has air as his soul, Who has sky as his belly, Who has moon and sun as eyes, Who has the four directions as ears, Who has the land of gods as head, Who has fire as his mouth, Who has sea as his stomach, And in whose belly play and enjoy, Gods, men birds, animals, Serpent men, Gandharvas and Asuras.

verses.devanagari: ॐ शांताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभांगम् । लक्ष्मीकांतं कमलनयनं योगिहृद्ध्यानगम्यं वंदे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥ ३ ॥
verses.iast: oṃ śāṁtākāraṁ bhujagaśayanaṁ padmanābhaṁ surēśaṁ viśvādhāraṁ gaganasadr̥śaṁ mēghavarṇaṁ śubhāṁgam, lakṣmīkāṁtaṁ kamalanayanaṁ yōgihr̥ddhyānagamyaṁ vaṁdē viṣṇuṁ bhavabhayaharaṁ sarvalōkaikanātham.
verses.meaning: I bow before the God Vishnu, Who is personification of peace, Who sleeps on his folded arms, Who has a lotus on his belly, Who is the God of gods, Who is the basis of earth, Who is like the sky, Who is of the colour of the cloud, Who has beautiful limbs, Who is the consort of Lakshmi, Who has lotus like eyes, Who is seen by saints through thought, Who kills all worries and fears, And who is the lord of all the worlds.

verses.devanagari: मेघश्यामं पीतकौशेयवासं श्रीवत्सांकं कौस्तुभोद्भासितांगम् । पुण्योपेतं पुंडरीकायताक्षं विष्णुं वंदे सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥ ४ ॥
verses.iast: mēghaśyāmaṁ pītakauśēyavāsaṁ śrīvatsāṁkaṁ kaustubhōdbhāsitāṁgam, puṇyōpētaṁ puṁḍarīkāyatākṣaṁ viṣṇuṁ vaṁdē sarvalōkaikanātham.
verses.meaning: I bow before that God Vishnu, Who is the lord of all the universe, Who is black like a cloud, Who wears yellow silks, Who has the sreevatsa on him, Whose limbs shine because of Kousthubha, Who has eyes like an open lotus, And who is surrounded by the blessed always.

verses.devanagari: नमः समस्तभूतानामादिभूताय भूभृते । अनेकरूपरूपाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ॥ ५ ॥
verses.iast: namaḥ samastabhūtānāmādibhūtāya bhūbhṛte, anekarūparūpāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave.
verses.meaning: Obeisance to Vishnu, the origin of all beings, the sustainer of the earth, the form of many forms, the originator.

verses.devanagari: सशंखचक्रं सकिरीटकुंडलं सपीतवस्त्रं  सरसीरुहेक्षणम् । सहारवक्षःस्थलशोभिकौस्तुभं नमामि विष्णुं शिरसा चतुर्भुजम् ॥ ६ ॥
verses.iast: saśaṁkhacakraṁ sakirīṭakuṁḍalaṁ sapītavastraṁ  sarasīruhēkṣaṇam, sahāravakṣaḥsthalaśōbhikaustubhaṁ namāmi viṣṇuṁ śirasā caturbhujam.
verses.meaning: I bow before the God Vishnu, Who has four arms, Who has a conch and wheel in his hands, Who wears a crown and ear globes, Who wears yellow silks, Who has lotus like eyes, Who shines because of Kousthbha gem worn on his garlanded chest.

verses.devanagari: छायायां पारिजातस्य हेमसिंहासनोपरि आसीनमंबुदश्याममायताक्षमलंकृतम् । चंद्राननं चतुर्बाहुं श्रीवत्सांकित वक्षसम् रुक्मिणीसत्यभामाभ्यां सहितं कृष्णमाश्रये ॥ ७ ॥
verses.iast: chāyāyāṁ pārijātasya hēmasiṁhāsanōpari āsīnamaṁbudaśyāmamāyatākṣamalaṁkr̥tam, caṁdrānanaṁ caturbāhuṁ śrīvatsāṁkita vakṣasam rukmiṇīsatyabhāmābhyāṁ sahitaṁ kr̥ṣṇamāśrayē.
verses.meaning: I seek refuge in Lord Krishna, Who is with Rukhmani and Satyabhama, Who sits on a golden throne in the shade of Parijata tree, Who is of the colour of the black cloud, Who has long broad eyes, Who has a face like moon, Who has four hands, And who has a chest adorned by Sreevatsa. STOTRAM — 1000 NAMES

sections.label: Stotram
sections.note: The thousand names across a hundred and eight stanzas. Every name is glossed on its own — open a stanza to read them.

verses.devanagari: विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कारो भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः । भूतकृद्भूतभृद्भावो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ १ ॥
verses.iast: viśvaṁ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkārō bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ, bhūtakṛdbhūtabhṛdbhāvō bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ.

words.meaning: The all or the Universe.
He who pervades everything.
For whom the sacrificial verses are uttered in the yajnas.
The one who is the master and beyond the past, present and the future.
The creator and destroyer of all existences in the universe.
One who supports or sustains or governs the universe.
Pure existence.
The essence of all beings.
He who originates and develops all Elements.

verses.devanagari: पूतात्मा परमात्मा च मुक्तानां परमा गतिः । अव्ययः पुरुषः साक्षी क्षेत्रज्ञोक्षर एव च ॥ २ ॥
verses.iast: pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṁ paramā gatiḥ, avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajñōkṣara eva ca.

words.meaning: One whose nature is purity/who is purity.
He who is the supreme one and the Atman.
The highest goal of the liberated ones.
One for whom there is no decay.
One who abides in the body or pura.
One who witnesses everything.
The knower of the field or body.
He who is without destruction.

verses.devanagari: योगो योगविदां नेता प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः । नारसिंहवपुः श्रीमान् केशवः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ ३ ॥
verses.iast: yōgō yōgavidāṁ netā pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ, nārasiṁhavapuḥ śrīmān keśavaḥ puruṣōttamaḥ.

words.meaning: One attainable through Yoga.
The master of those who are established in the above-mentioned Yoga.
The master of pradhana or Prakriti and Purusha or Jiva.
One in whom the bodies of a man and a lion are combined.
One on whose chest the goddess Shri always dwells.
One whose Kesa or locks are beautiful.
The greatest among all Purushas.

verses.devanagari: सर्वः शर्वः शिवः स्थाणुर्भूतादिर्निधिरव्ययः । संभवो भावनो भर्ता प्रभवः प्रभुरीश्वरः ॥ ४ ॥
verses.iast: sarvaḥ śarvaḥ śivaḥ sthāṇurbhūtādirnidhiravyayaḥ, saṁbhavō bhāvanō bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ.

words.meaning: The omniscient source of all existence.
Destroyer.
One pure.
One who is steady, immovable and changeless.
Source of all elements or existing things.
The changeless and indestructible Being in whom the whole universe becomes merged and remains in seminal condition at the time of Pralaya or cosmic dissolution.
One born out of His own will as incarnation.
One who generates the fruits or Karmas of all Jivas for them to enjoy.
One who supports the universe as its substratum.
One from whom all the great elements have their birth. Or one who has exalted births as incarnations.
One who is an adept in all rites.
One who has unlimited lordliness or power over all things.

verses.devanagari: स्वयंभूः शंभुरादित्यः पुष्कराक्षो महास्वनः । अनादिनिधनो धाता विधाता धातुरुत्तमः ॥ ५ ॥
verses.iast: svayaṁbhūḥ śaṁbhurādityaḥ puṣkarākṣō mahāsvanaḥ, anādinidhanō dhātā vidhātā dhāturuttamaḥ.

words.meaning: One who exists by Himself, uncaused by any other.
One who bestows happiness on devotees.
The golden-hued person in the sun's orb.
One who has eyes resembling the petals of Pushkara or lotus.
One from whom comes the great sound – the Veda.
The one existence that has neither birth nor death.
One who is the support of the universe.
He who generates Karmas and their fruits.
The ultimate support of every thing.

verses.devanagari: अप्रमेयो हृषीकेशः पद्मनाभोऽमरप्रभुः । विश्वकर्मा मनुस्व्तष्टा स्थविष्ठः स्थविरो ध्रुवः ॥ ६ ॥
verses.iast: aprameyō hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho’maraprabhuḥ, viśvakarmā manusvtaṣṭā sthaviṣṭhaḥ sthaviro dhruvaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is not measurable or understandable by any of the accepted means of knowledge like sense, perception, inference etc.
The master of the senses or He under whose control the senses subsist.
He in whose navel (nabhi) the lotus (padma), the source of the universe, stands.
The master of Amaras or the deathless ones, i.e. the Devas.
He whose Karma (work) has resulted in all that exists (Vishvam) or He whose power of creation is unique and wonderful.
He who thinks.
He who makes all beings shrunken (Tanukarana) at the time of cosmic dissolution.
He who excels in everything in bulk or substantiality.
Eternal One, being the most ancient. It is taken as a single phrase, the name along with its qualification.

verses.devanagari: अग्राह्यः शाश्वतः कृष्णो लोहिताक्षः प्रतर्दनः । प्रभूतस्त्रिककुब्धाम पवित्रं मंगलं परम् ॥ ७ ॥
verses.iast: agrāhyaḥ śāśvataḥ kṛṣṇō lōhitākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ, prabhūtastrikakubdhāma pavitraṁ maṁgalaṁ param.

words.meaning: One who cannot be grasped by the organs or knowledge or conceived by the mind.
One who exists at all times.
The existence-Knowledge-Bliss.
One whose eyes are tinged red.
Destroyer of all at the time of cosmic dissolution.
Great because of unique qualities like omnipotence, omniscience etc.
He who is the support (dharma) of the three regions above, below and in the middle.
That which purifies everything.
Supremely auspicious.

verses.devanagari: ईशानः प्राणदः प्राणो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः प्रजापतिः । हिरण्यगर्भो भूगर्भो माधवो मधुसूदनः ॥ ८ ॥
verses.iast: īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇō jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ, hiraṇyagarbhō bhūgarbhō mādhavō madhusūdanaḥ.

words.meaning: He who controls and regulates everything.
One who bestows or activates the Prana, the vital energy.
The Supreme Being.
The eldest of all; for there is nothing before Him.
One deserving the highest praise.
The master of all living beings, because He is Ishvara.
One who is Atman of even Brahma the creator.
One who has got the world within Himself.
The Consort of Ma or Mahalakshmi or one who is fit to be known through Madhu-Vidya.
The destroyer of the demon Madhu.

verses.devanagari: ईश्वरो विक्रमी धन्वी मेधावी विक्रमः क्रमः । अनुत्तमो दुराधर्षः कृतज्ञः कृतिरात्मवान् ॥ ९ ॥
verses.iast: īśvarō vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ, anuttamō durādharṣaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kṛtirātmavān.

words.meaning: The Omnipotent Being.
The courageous One.
One armed with bow.
He who has great intelligence capable of grasping all texts.
He who crosses (Karmana) i.e. transcends samsara. Or one who has Vih, bird i.e. Garuda as His mount.
Vishnu is called Kramah, because He is the cause of Kramana or crossing of the ocean of samsara by devotees, or because from Him all Krama or manifestation of the universe, has taken place.
He than whom there is none greater.
One whom none (Asuras) can overcome.
One who knows everything about what has been done (Kruta) by Jivas. Also one who is pleased even with those who offer such simple offerings as leaves, flowers, fruits and water.
The word means what is achieved through all human efforts or works.
One established in his own greatness i.e. requiring no other support than Himself.

verses.devanagari: सुरेशः शरणं शर्म विश्वरेताः प्रजाभवः । अहः संवत्सरो व्यालः प्रत्ययस्सर्वदर्शनः ॥ १० ॥
verses.iast: sureśaḥ śaraṇaṁ śarma viśvaretāḥ prajābhavaḥ, ahaḥ saṁvatsarō vyālaḥ pratyayassarvadarśanaḥ.

words.meaning: The lord of the Suras or Devas. It can also mean the greatest of those who bestow good.
One who removes the sorrows of those in distress.
One who is of the nature of supreme bliss.
The seed of the universe.
He from whom all beings have originated.
Luminous one.
As Time is a from of Vishnu, He is called Samvasara or a year.
Being ungraspable like a serpent, He is called Vyalah.
One who is of the nature of Pratiti or Prajna (consciousness).
One with eyes everywhere. As the Lord has assumed all forms, the eye-sight of all beings is His.

verses.devanagari: अजः सर्वेश्वरः सिद्धः सिद्धिः सर्वादिरच्युतः । वृषाकपिरमेयात्मा सर्वयोगविनिःसृतः ॥ ११ ॥
verses.iast: ajaḥ sarveśvaraḥ siddhaḥ siddhiḥ sarvādiracyutaḥ, vṛṣākapirameyātmā sarvayōgaviniḥsṛtaḥ.

words.meaning: One who has no birth.
The Lord of all Lords or the supreme Lord.
One ever established in one's own nature.
One who is of the nature of Consciousness in all.
One who is the first cause of all elements.
One who never lost and will never lose his inherent nature and powers.
One who shwers all objects of desire.
One whose form or nature cannot be measured and determined.
One who stands aside completely from all bondage.

verses.devanagari: वसुर्वसुमनाः सत्यः समात्मा सम्मितः समः । अमोघः पुण्डरीकाक्षो वृषकर्मा वृषाकृतिः ॥ १२ ॥
verses.iast: vasurvasumanāḥ satyaḥ samātmā sammitaḥ samaḥ, amōghaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣō vṛṣakarmā vṛṣākṛtiḥ.

words.meaning: One in whom all beings dwell and one who dwells in all beings.
The term Vasu means wealth or riches. Here it indicates greatness. So it means one possessed of a great mind i.e. a mind free from attachments, anger and other evil qualities.
One whose nature is Truth.
One whose mind is Sama, without partiality or anger and thus the same towards all beings.
This name and the previous (samatma) occurring together, can be split in two ways – as samātmā + sammitaḥ and as samātmā + asammitaḥ.
One unpertubed at all times.
One whose worship will never go in vain, but will bear ample fruits.
One who has pervaded, i.e. is realized in, the lotus of the heart. Or One whose eyes resemble the petals of a lotus.
One whose actions are according to Vrushas i.e. Dharma.
One who takes form for the sake of Vrushas or Dharma.

verses.devanagari: रुद्रो बहुशिरा बभ्रुर्विश्वयोनिः शुचिश्रवाः । अमृतः शाश्वतः स्थाणुर्वरारोहो महातपाः ॥ १३ ॥
verses.iast: rudrō bahuśirā babhrurviśvayōniḥ śuciśravāḥ, amṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ sthāṇurvarārōhō mahātapāḥ.

words.meaning: One who makes all beings cry at the time of cosmic dissolution.
One with innumerable heads.
One who governs the world.
One who is the cause of the world.
One whose names and glories are very holy and purifying to be heard.
One who is deathless.
One who is both eternal and firmly established, unchanging.
He whose lap gives the highest blessings.
The austerity connected with creation, which is of the nature of knowledge is of great potency.

verses.devanagari: सर्वगः सर्वविद्भानुर्विष्वक्सेनो जनार्दनः । वेदो वेदविदव्यङ्गो वेदाङ्गो वेदवित् कविः ॥ १४ ॥
verses.iast: sarvagaḥ sarvavidbhānurviṣvaksenō janārdanaḥ, vedō vedavidavyaṅgō vedāṅgō vedavit kaviḥ.

words.meaning: One who pervades everything, being of the nature of their material cause.
One who is omniscient and illumines everything.
He before whom all Asura armies get scattered.
One who inflicts suffering on evil men.
He who is of the form of the Veda.
One who knows the Veda and its meaning.
One who is self-fulfilled by knowledge and other great attributes and is free from every defect.
He to whom the Vedas stand as organs.
One who knows all the Vedas.
One who sees everything.

verses.devanagari: लोकाध्यक्षः सुराध्यक्षो धर्माध्यक्षः कृताकृत । चतुरात्मा चतुर्व्यूहश्चतुर्दंष्ट्रश्चतुर्भुजः ॥ १५ ॥
verses.iast: lōkādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣō dharmādhyakṣaḥ kṛtākṛta: caturātmā caturvyūhaścaturdaṁṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ.

words.meaning: He who witnesses the whole universe.
One who is the overlord of the protecting Divinities of all regions.
One who directly sees the merits (Dharma) and demerits (Adharma) of beings by bestwing their due rewards on all beings.
One who is an effect in the form of the worlds and also a non-effect as their cause.
One who for the sake of creation, sustentation and dissolution assumes forms.
One who adopts a fourfold manifestation.
One with four fangs in His Incarnation as Nisimha.
One with four arms.

verses.devanagari: भ्राजिष्णुर्भोजनं भोक्ता सहिष्णुर्जगदादिजः । अनघो विजयो जेता विश्वयोनिः पुनर्वसुः ॥ १६ ॥
verses.iast: bhrājiṣṇurbhōjanaṁ bhōktā sahiṣṇurjagadādijaḥ, anaghō vijayō jetā viśvayōniḥ punarvasuḥ.

words.meaning: One who is pure luminosity.
Prakruti or Maya is called Bhojanam or what is enjoyed by the Lord.
As he, purusha, enjoys the prakruti, He is called the enjoyer or Bhokta.
As He suppresses Asuras like Kiranyaksha, He is Sahishnu.
One who manifested as Hiranyagarbha by Himself at the beginning of creation.
The sinless one.
One who has mastery over the whole universe by virtue of his six special excellences like omnipotence, omniscience etc. known as Bhagas.
One who is naturally victorious over beings, i.e. superior to all beings.
The source of the universe.
One who dwells again and again in the bodies as the Jivas.

verses.devanagari: उपेन्द्रो वामनः प्रांशुरमोघः शुचिरूर्जितः । अतीन्द्रः सङ्ग्रहः सर्गो धृतात्मा नियमो यम ॥ १७ ॥
verses.iast: upendrō vāmanaḥ prāṁśuramōghaḥ śucirūrjitaḥ. atīndraḥ saṅgrahaḥ sargō dhṛtātmā niyamō yama.

words.meaning: One born as the younger brother of Indra.
One who, in the form of Vamana (dwarf), went begging to Bali.
One of great height.
One whose acts do not go in vain.
One who purifies those who adore and praise Him.
One of infinite strength.
One who is superior to Indra by His inherent attributes like omnipotence, omniscience etc.
One who is of the subtle form of the universe to be created.
The creator of Himself
One who is ever in His inherent form or nature, without the transformation involved in birth and death.
One who appoints His creatures in particular stations.
One who regulates all, remaining within them.

verses.devanagari: वेद्यो वैद्यः सदायोगी वीरहा माधवो मधुः । अतीन्द्रियो महामायो महोत्साहो महाबलः ॥ १८ ॥
verses.iast: vedyō vaidyaḥ sadāyōgī vīrahā mādhavō madhuḥ, atīndriyō mahāmāyō mahōtsāhō mahābalaḥ.

words.meaning: One who has to be known by those who aspire for Mokshas.
One who knows all Vidyas or branches of knowledge.
One who is ever experienceble, being ever existent.
One who destroys heroic Asuras for the protection of Dharma.
One who is the Lord or Master of Ma or knowledge.
Honey, because the Lord gives joy, just like honey.
One who is not knowable by the senses.
One who can cause illusion even over other great illusionists.
One who is ever busy in the work of creation, sustentation and dissolution.
The strongest among all who have strength.

verses.devanagari: महाबुद्धिर्महावीर्यो महाशक्तिर्महाद्युतिः । अनिर्देश्यवपुः श्रीमानमेयात्मा महाद्रिधृक् ॥ १९ ॥
verses.iast: mahābuddhirmahāvīryō mahāśaktirmahādyutiḥ, anirdeśyavapuḥ śrīmānameyātmā mahādridhṛk.

words.meaning: The wisest among the wise.
The most powerful one, because Ignorance which is the cause of Samsara is His great power.
One with great resources of strength and skill.
One who is intensely brilliant both within and without.
One who cannot be indicated to another as: 'He is this', because He cannot be objectively known.
One endowed with greatness of every kind.
The Spirit with intelligence that cannot be measured by any one.
One who held up the great mountain 'Mandara' at the time of the churning of the Milk Ocean and also Govardhana in his Krishna incarnation.

verses.devanagari: महेष्वासो महीभर्ता श्रीनिवासः सतां गतिः । अनिरुद्धः सुरानन्दो गोविन्दो गोविदां पतिः ॥ २० ॥
verses.iast: maheṣvāsō mahībhartā śrīnivāsaḥ satāṁ gatiḥ, aniruddhaḥ surānandō gōvindō gōvidāṁ patiḥ.

words.meaning: One equipped with the great bow.
One who held up the earth submerged in Pralaya waters.
One on whose chest the Goddess Shri, eternal in nature, dwells.
One who bestows the highest destiny attainable, to all holy men.
One who has never been obstructed by any one or anything from manifesting in various forms.
One who bestows joy on all divinities.
Gau means words. Thou pervadest all words, giving them power. Therefore sages call the Govinda.
Gau means words. One who knows them is Govid. He who is the master of words is indicated by this name.

verses.devanagari: मरीचिर्दमनो हंसः सुपर्णो भुजगोत्तमः । हिरण्यनाभः सुतपाः पद्मनाभः प्रजापति ॥ २१ ॥
verses.iast: marīcirdamanō haṁsaḥ suparṇō bhujagōttamaḥ, hiraṇyanābhaḥ sutapāḥ padmanābhaḥ prajāpati

words.meaning: The supreme power and impressiveness seen in persons endowed with such qualities.
One who in the form of Yama inflicts punishments on those who tread the path of unrighteousness.
One who removes the fear of Samsara from those who practise the sense of identity with Him.
One who has two wings in the shape of Dharma and Adharma.
One who is the greatest among those who move on Bhujas or arms, that is, serpents. The great serpents like Ananta and Vasuki are the powers of Vishnu, so he has come to have this name.
From whose golden navel arose the lord of creation Brahmā.
One who performs rigorous austerities at Badarikashrama as Nara and Narayana.
One whose navel is beautifully shaped like lotus.
The father of all beings, who are His children.

verses.devanagari: अमृत्युः सर्वदृक् सिंहः सन्धाता सन्धिमान् स्थिरः । अजो दुर्मर्षणः शास्ता विश्रुतात्मा सुरारिहा ॥ २२ ॥
verses.iast: amṛtyuḥ sarvadṛk siṁhaḥ sandhātā sandhimān sthiraḥ, ajō durmarṣaṇaḥ śāstā viśrutātmā surārihā.

words.meaning: One who is without death or its cause.
One who sees the Karmas of all Jivas through His inherent wisdom.
One who does Himsa or destruction.
One who unites the Jivas with the fruits of their actions.
One who is Himself the enjoyer of the fruits of actions.
One who is always of the same nature.
The root 'Aj' has got as meanings both 'go' and 'throw'. So the name means One who goes into the hearts of devotees or One who throws the evil Asuras to a distance, i.e. destroys them.
One whose might the Asuras cannot bear.
One who instructs and directs all through the scriptures.
One who is specially known through signifying terms like Truth, Knowledge, etc.
One who destroys the enemies of Suras or Devas.

verses.devanagari: गुरुर्गुरुतमो धामः सत्यः सत्यपराक्रमः । निमिषो निमिषः स्रग्वी वाचस्पतिरुदारधीः ॥ २३ ॥
verses.iast: gururgurutamō dhāmaḥ satyaḥ satyaparākramaḥ, nimiṣō nimiṣaḥ sragvī vācaspatirudāradhīḥ.

words.meaning: The greatest teacher.
One who is the teacher of all forms of knowledge.
The Supreme Light.
One who is embodied as virtue of truth specially.
One of unfailing valour.
One whose eye-lids are closed in Yoga-nidra.
One who is ever awake.
One who has on Him the necklace called Vaijayanti, which is strung with the subtle aspects of the five elements.
Being the master of Vak or word i.e. knowledge, He is called so. As his intellect perceives everything, He is Udaradhih. Both these epithets together constitute one name.

verses.devanagari: अग्रणीर्ग्रामणीः श्रीमान् न्यायो नेता समीरणः । सहस्रमूर्धा विश्वात्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ॥ २४ ॥
verses.iast: agraṇīrgrāmaṇīḥ śrīmān nyāyō netā samīraṇaḥ, sahasramūrdhā viśvātmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt.

words.meaning: One who leads all liberation-seekers to the highest status.
One who has the command over Bhutagrama or the collectivity of all beings.
One more resplendent than everything.
The consistency which runs through all ways of knowing and which leads one to the truth of Non-duality.
One who moves this world of becoming.
One with a thousand, i.e. innumerable, heads.
One who in the form of breath keeps all living beings functioning.
The soul of the universe.
One with a thousand or innumerable eyes.
One with a thousand, i.e. innumerable legs.

verses.devanagari: आवर्तनो निवृत्तात्मा संवृतः संप्रमर्दनः । अहः संवर्तको वह्निरनिलो धरणीधरः ॥ २५ ॥
verses.iast: āvartanō nivṛttātmā saṁvṛtaḥ saṁpramardanaḥ, ahaḥ saṁvartakō vahniranilō dharaṇīdharaḥ.

words.meaning: One who whirls round and round the Samsara- chakra, the wheel of Samsara or worldy existence.
One whose being is free or untouched by the bondage of Samsara.
One who is covered by all-covering Avidya or ignorance.
One who delivers destructive blows on all beings through His Vibhutis (power manifestation like Rudra, Yama etc.).
The Lord who, as the sun, regulates the succession of day and night.
One who as fire carries the offerings made to the Devas in sacrifices.
One who has no fixed residence.
One who supports the worlds, Adisesha, elephants of the quarters, etc.

verses.devanagari: सुप्रसादः प्रसन्नात्मा विश्वधृग्विश्वभुग्विभुः । सत्कर्ता सत्कृतः साधुर्जह्नुर्नारायणो नरः ॥ २६ ॥
verses.iast: suprasādaḥ prasannātmā viśvadhṛgviśvabhugvibhuḥ, satkartā satkṛtaḥ sādhurjahnurnārāyaṇō naraḥ.

words.meaning: One whose Prasada or mercy is uniquely wonderful, because He gives salvation to Sisupala and others who try to harm Him.
One whose mind is never contaminated by Rajas or Tamas.
One who holds the universe by his power.
One who eats up or enjoys or protects the worlds.
One who takes various forms
One who offers benefits.
One who is adored even by those who deserve adoration.
One who acts according to justice.
One who dissolves all beings in oneself at the time of dissolution.
Nara means Atman. Narayana, that is, one having His residence in all beings.
He directs everything, the eternal Paramatma is called Nara.

verses.devanagari: असङ्ख्येयोऽप्रमेयात्मा विशिष्टः शिष्टकृच्छुचिः । सिद्धार्थः सिद्धसङ्कल्पः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिसाधनः ॥ २७ ॥
verses.iast: asaṅkhyeyō’prameyātmā viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭakṛcchuciḥ, siddhārthaḥ siddhasaṅkalpaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhisādhanaḥ.

words.meaning: One who has no Sankhya or differences of name and form.
One whose nature cannot be grasped by any of the means of knowledge.
One who excels everything.
One who commands everything. Or one who protects shishtas or good men.
Pure
One whose object is always fulfilled.
One whose resolutions are always fulfilled.
One who bestows Siddhi or fulfillment on all who practise disciplines, in accordance with their eligibility.
One who brings fulfillment to works that deserve the same.

verses.devanagari: वृषाही वृषभो विष्णुर्वृषपर्वा वृषोदरः । वर्धनो वर्धमानश्च विविक्तः श्रुतिसागरः ॥ २८ ॥
verses.iast: vṛṣāhī vṛṣabhō viṣṇurvṛṣaparvā vṛṣōdaraḥ, vardhanō vardhamānaśca viviktaḥ śrutisāgaraḥ.

words.meaning: Vrusha means dharma or merit.
One who showers on the devotees all that they pray for.
One who pervades everything.
One who has given as steps (Parvas), observances of the nature of Dharma, to those who want to attain the supreme state.
One whose abdomen showers offspring.
One who increases the ecstasy of His devotees
One who multiplies in the form of the universe.
One who is untouched and unaffected.
One to whom all the shruti or Vedic words and sentences flow.

verses.devanagari: सुभुजो दुर्धरो वाग्मी महेन्द्रो वसुदो वसुः । नैकरूपो बृहद्रूपः शिपिविष्टः प्रकाशनः ॥ २९ ॥
verses.iast: subhujō durdharō vāgmī mahendrō vasudō vasuḥ, naikarūpō bṛhadrūpaḥ śipiviṣṭaḥ prakāśanaḥ.

words.meaning: One possessing excellent arms that protect the worlds.
One who holds up the universe – a work which none else can do.
One from whom the words constituting the Veda come out.
The great Lord, that is, the Supreme Being, who is the God of all gods.
One who bestows riches.
One who is himself the Vasu.
One who is without an exclusive form.
One who has adopted mysterious forms like that of a Boar.
Shipi means cow. One who resides in cows as Yajna.
One who illumines everthing.

verses.devanagari: ओजस्तेजोद्युतिधरः प्रकाशात्मा प्रतापनः । ऋद्धः स्पष्टाक्षरो मन्त्रश्चन्द्रांशुर्भास्करद्युतिः ॥ ३० ॥
verses.iast: ōjastejōdyutidharaḥ prakāśātmā pratāpanaḥ, ṛddhaḥ spaṣṭākṣarō mantraścandrāṁśurbhāskaradyutiḥ.

words.meaning: One who is endowed with strength, vigour and brilliance.
One whose form is radiant.
One who warms the world through the power manifestations like the Sun.
One who is rich in excellences like Dharma, Gyana (knowledge), Vairagya (renunciation) etc.
He is so called because Omkara, the manifesting sound of the Lord, is Spashta or high pitched.
One who manifests as the Mantras of the Rk, Sama, Yajus etc., or one who is known through Mantras.
He is called 'Chandramshu' or moonlight because just as the moon-light gives relief to men burnt in the heat of the sun, He gives relief and shelter to those who are subjected to the heat of Samsara.
He who has the effulgence of the sun.

verses.devanagari: अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुः शशबिन्दुः सुरेश्वरः । औषधं जगतः सेतुः सत्यधर्मपराक्रमः ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.iast: amṛtāṁśūdbhavō bhānuḥ śaśabinduḥ sureśvaraḥ, auṣadhaṁ jagataḥ setuḥ satyadharmaparākramaḥ.

words.meaning: The Paramatman from whom Amrutamshu or the Moon originated at the time of the churning of the Milk-ocean.
One who shines.
The word means one who has the mark of the hare, that is the Moon.
One who is the Lord of all Devas and those who do good.
One who is the Aushadha or medicine for the great disease of Samsara.
One who is the aid to go across the ocean of Samsara.
One whose excellences like righteousness, omniscience, puissance, etc. are all true.

verses.devanagari: भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः पवनः पावनोऽनलः । कामहा कामकृत्कान्तः कामः कामप्रदः प्रभुः ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.iast: bhūtabhavyabhavannāthaḥ pavanaḥ pāvano’nalaḥ, kāmahā kāmakṛtkāntaḥ kāmaḥ kāmapradaḥ prabhuḥ.

words.meaning: One who is the master for all the beings of the past, future and present.
One who is the purifier.
One who causes movement.
The Jivatma is called Anala because it recognizes Ana or Prana as Himself.
One who destroys the desire-nature in seekers after liberation.
One who fulfils the wants of pure minded devotees.
One who is extremely beautiful.
One who is sought after by those who desire to attain the four supreme values of life.
One who liberally fulfils the desires of devotees.
One who surpasses all.

verses.devanagari: युगादिकृद्युगावर्तो नैकमायो महाशनः । अदृश्यो व्यक्तरूपश्च सहस्रजिदनन्तजित् ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.iast: yugādikṛdyugāvartō naikamāyō mahāśanaḥ, adṛśyō vyaktarūpaśca sahasrajidanantajit.

words.meaning: One who is the cause of periods of time like Yuga.
One who as time causes the repetition of the four Yugas beginning with Satya Yuga.
One who can assume numerous forms of Maya, not one only.
One who consumes everything at the end of a Kalpa.
One who cannot be grasped by any of the five organs of knowledge.
He is so called because His gross form as universe can be clearly perceived.
One who is victorious over innumerable enemies of the Devas in battle.
One who, being endowed with all powers, is victorious at all times over everything.

verses.devanagari: इष्टोऽविशिष्टः शिष्टेष्टः शिखण्डी नहुषो वृषः । क्रोधहा क्रोधकृत्कर्ता विश्वबाहुर्महीधरः ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.iast: iṣṭō’viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭeṣṭaḥ śikhaṇḍī nahuṣō vṛṣaḥ, krōdhahā krōdhakṛtkartā viśvabāhurmahīdharaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is dear to all because He is of the nature of supreme Bliss.
One who resides within all.
One who is dear to shishta or Knowing Ones.
Sikhanda means feather of a peacock. One who used it as a decoration for His crown when he adopted the form of a cowherd (Gopa).
One who binds all beings by Maya the root 'nah' means bondage.
One who is of the form of Dharma.
One who eradicates anger in virtuous people.
One who generates Krodha or anger in evil people.
One who is the support of all or one who has got all beings as His arms.
Mahi means both earth and worship. So the name means one who supports the earth or receives all forms of worship.

verses.devanagari: अच्युतः प्रथितः प्राणः प्राणदो वासवानुजः । अपांनिधिरधिष्ठानमप्रमत्तः प्रतिष्ठितः ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.iast: acyutaḥ prathitaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadō vāsavānujaḥ, apāṁnidhiradhiṣṭhānamapramattaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is without the six transformations beginning with birth.
One who is famous because of His works like creation of the worlds etc.
One who as Hiranyagarbha endows all beings with Prana.
One who bestows Prana, that is, strength, on Devas and Asuras and also destroys them by withdrawing it.
One who was born as younger brother of Indra (Vasava) in His incarnation as Vamana.
The word means collectivity of water or the ocean.
The seat or support for everything.
One who is always vigilant in awarding the fruits of actions to those who are entiled to them.
One who is supported and established in His own greatness.

verses.devanagari: स्कन्दः स्कन्दधरो धुर्यो वरदो वायुवाहनः । वासुदेवो बृहद्भानुरादिदेवः पुरन्दरः ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.iast: skandaḥ skandadharō dhuryō varadō vāyuvāhanaḥ, vāsudevō bṛhadbhānurādidevaḥ purandaraḥ.

words.meaning: One who drives everything as air.
One who supports Skanda or the righteous path.
One who bears the weight of the burden of all beings in the form of birth etc.
One who gives boons.
One who vibrates the seven Vayus or atmospheres beginning with Avaha.
One who is both Vasu and Deva.
The great brilliance.
The Divinity who is the source of all Devas.
One who destroys the cities of the enemies of Devas.

verses.devanagari: अशोकस्तारणस्तारः शूरः शौरिर्जनेश्वरः । अनुकूलः शतावर्तः पद्मी पद्मनिभेक्षणः ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.iast: aśōkastāraṇastāraḥ śūraḥ śaurirjaneśvaraḥ, anukūlaḥ śatāvartaḥ padmī padmanibhekṣaṇaḥ.

words.meaning: One without the six defects – sorrow, infatuation, hunger, thirst, birth and death.
One who uplifts beings from the ocean of samsara.
One who liberates beings from the fear of residence in the womb, birth, old age, death etc.
One of great prowess, that is, who fulfils the four supreme satisfactions of life – Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha.
One who as Krishna as the son of Sura, that is Vasudeva.
The Lord of all beings.
One who, being the Atman of all beings, is favorable to all, for no one will act against oneself.
One who has had several Avataras or incarnations.
One having Padma or lotus in his hands.
One with eyes resembling lotus.

verses.devanagari: पद्मनाभोरविन्दाक्षः पद्मगर्भः शरीरभृत् । महर्द्धिर् ऋद्धो वृद्धात्मा महाक्षो गरुडध्वजः ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.iast: padmanābhōravindākṣaḥ padmagarbhaḥ śarīrabhṛt, maharddhir ṛddhō vṛddhātmā mahākṣō garuḍadhvajaḥ.

words.meaning: One who resides in the Nabhi or the central part of the heart-lotus.
One whose eyes resemble Aravinda or the Lotus.
One who is fit to be worshipped in the middle of the heart-lotus.
One who supports the bodies of beings, strengthening them in the form of Anna (Food) and Prana.
One who has enormous Ruddhi or prosperity.
One who is seen as standing in the form of the world.
One whose Atma or body is Vruddha or ancient.
One who has got two or many glorious eyes.
One who has got Garuda as his flag.

verses.devanagari: अतुलः शरभो भीमः समयज्ञो हविर्हरिः । सर्वलक्षणलक्षण्यो लक्ष्मीवान् समितिञ्जयः ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.iast: atulaḥ śarabhō bhīmaḥ samayajñō havirhariḥ, sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇyō lakṣmīvān samitiñjayaḥ.

words.meaning: One who cannot be compared to anything else.
The body is called 'Sara' as it is perishable.
One of whom everyone is afraid.
One who knows the time for creation, sustentation and dissolution.
One who takes the portion of offerings (Havis) in Yajnas.
The supreme knowledge obtained through all criteria of knowledge i.e. Paramatma.
One on whose chest the Goddess Lakshmi is always residing.
One who is vicotious in Samiti or war.

verses.devanagari: विक्षरो रोहितो मार्गो हेतुर्दमोदरस्सहः । महीधरो महाभागो वेगवानमिताशनः ॥ ४० ॥
verses.iast: vikṣarō rōhitō mārgō heturdamodarassahaḥ, mahīdharō mahābhāgō vegavānamitāśanaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is without Kshara or desruction.
One who assumed the form of a kind of fish called Rohita.
One who is sought after by persons seeking Moksha or Liberation.
One who is both the instrumental and the material cause of the universe.
One who has very benevolent mind because of disciplines like self-control.
One who subordinates everything.
One who props up the earth in the form of mountain.
He who, taking a body by His own will, enjoys supreme felicities.
One of tremendous speed.
He who consumes all the worlds at the time of Dissolution.

verses.devanagari: उद्भवः । क्षोभणो देवः श्रीगर्भः परमेश्वरः । करणं कारणं कर्ता विकर्ता गहनो गुहः ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.iast: udbhavaḥ, kṣōbhaṇō devaḥ śrīgarbhaḥ parameśvaraḥ, karaṇaṁ kāraṇaṁ kartā vikartā gahanō guhaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is the material cause of creation.
One who at the time of creation entered into the Purusha and Prakriti and caused agitation.
'Divyati' means sports oneself through creation and other cosmic activities.
One in whose abdomen (Garbha) Shri or His unique manifestation as Samsara has its existence.
'Parama' means the supreme. 'Ishvarah' means one who hold sway over all beings.
He who is the most important factor in the generation of this universe.
The Cause – He who causes others to act.
One who is free and is therefore one's own master.
One who makes this unique universe.
One whose nature, greatness and actions cannot be known by anybody.
One who hides one's own nature with the help of His power of Maya.

verses.devanagari: व्यवसायो व्यवस्थानः संस्थानः स्थानदो ध्रुवः । परर्द्धिः परमस्पष्टस्तुष्टः पुष्टः शुभेक्षणः ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.iast: vyavasāyō vyavasthānaḥ saṁsthānaḥ sthānadō dhruvaḥ, pararddhiḥ paramaspaṣṭastuṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is wholly of the nature of knowledge.
He in whom the orderly regulation of the universe rests.
One in whom all beings dwell in the states of dissolution.
One who gives their particular status to persons like Dhruva according to their Karma.
One who is indestructible.
One who possesses lordliness of this most exalted type.
One in whom 'Para' or supremely glorious 'Ma' or Lakshmi dwells. Or one who is the greatest of all beings without any other's help.
One who is of the nature of supreme.
One who in fills everything.

One whose Ikshanam or vision bestows good on all beings that is, gives liberation to those who want Moksha and enjoyments to those who are after it, and also cuts asunder the knots of the heart by eliminating all doubts.

verses.devanagari: रामो विरामो विरजो मार्गो नेयो नयोनयः । वीरः शक्तिमतां श्रेष्ठो धर्मो धर्मविदुत्तमः ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.iast: rāmō virāmō virajō mārgō neyō nayōnayaḥ, vīraḥ śaktimatāṁ śreṣṭhō dharmō dharmaviduttamaḥ.

words.meaning: The eternally blissful on in whom the Yogis find delight.
One in whom the Virama or end of all beings takes place.
One in whom the desire for enjoyments has ceased
The path.
One who directs or leads the Jiva to the Supreme Being through spiritual realization.
One who leads, that is, who is the leader in the form of spiritual illumination.
One for whom there is no leader.
One who is valorous.
One who is the most powerful among all powerful beings like Brahma.
One who supports all beings.
The greatest of knower of Dharma. He is called so because all the scriptures consisting of Shrutis and Smrutis form His commandments.

verses.devanagari: वैकुण्ठः पुरुषः प्राणः प्राणदः प्रणवः पृथुः । हिरण्यगर्भः शत्रुघ्नो व्याप्तो वायुरधोक्षजः ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.iast: vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ pṛthuḥ, hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śatrughnō vyāptō vāyuradhōkṣajaḥ.

words.meaning: The bringing together of the diversified categories is Vikuntha. He who is the agent of it is Vaikunthah.
One who existed before everything.
One who lives as Kshetrajana (knower in the body) or one who functions in the form of vital force called Prana.
One who is the giver of life.
One who is praised or to whom prostration is made with Om.
One who has expanded himself as the world.
He who was the cause of the golden- coloured egg out of which Brahma was born.
One who destroys the enemies of the Devas.
One who as the cause pervades all effects.
One who moves towards His devotees.
He is Adhokshaja because he undergoes no degeneration from His original nature.

verses.devanagari: ऋतुः सुदर्शनः कालः परमेष्ठी परिग्रहः । उग्रः संवत्सरो दक्षो विश्रामो विश्वदक्षिणः ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.iast: ṛtuḥ sudarśanaḥ kālaḥ parameṣṭhī parigrahaḥ, ugraḥ saṁvatsarō dakṣō viśrāmō viśvadakṣiṇaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is of the nature of Kala (time) which is indicated by the word Ritu or season.
One whose Darshana or vision that is knowledge, bestows the most auspicious fruit Moksha.
One who measures and sets a limit to everything.
One who dwells in his supreme greatness in the sky of the heart.
One who, being everywhere, is grasped on all sides by those who seek refuge in Him. Or one who grasps or receives the offerings made by devotees.
One who is the cause of fear even to beings like Sun.
One in whom all beings reside.
One who augments in the form of the world.

One who bestows Vishrama or liberation to aspirants who seek relief from the ocean of Samsara with its waves of various tribulations in the from of Hunger, Thirst etc., and difficulties like Avidya, pride, infatuation etc.
One who is more skilled (Daksha) than every one. Or One who is proficient in everything.

verses.devanagari: विस्तारः स्थावरःस्थाणुः प्रमाणं बीजमव्ययम् । अर्थोनर्थो महाकोशो महाभोगो महाधनः ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.iast: vistāraḥ sthāvaraḥsthāṇuḥ pramāṇaṁ bījamavyayam, arthōnarthō mahākōśō mahābhōgō mahādhanaḥ.

words.meaning: One in whom all the worlds have attained manifestation.
One who is firmly established is Sthavara, and in whom long lasting entities like earth are established in Sthanu. The Lord is both these.
One who is of the nature of pure consciousness.
One who is the seed or cause of Samsara without Himself undergoing any change.
One who is sought (Arthita) by all, as He is of the nature of bliss.
One who, being self-fulfilled, has no other Artha or end to seek.
One who has got as His covering the great Koshas like Annamaya, Pranamaya etc.
One who has Bliss as the great source of enjoyment.
One who has got the whole universe as the wealth (Dhana) for His enjoyment.

verses.devanagari: अनिर्विण्णः स्थविष्ठोभूर्धर्मयूपो महामखः । नक्षत्रनेमिर्नक्षत्री क्षमः क्षामः समीहनः ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.iast: anirviṇṇaḥ sthaviṣṭhōbhūrdharmayūpō mahāmakhaḥ. nakṣatranemirnakṣatrī kṣamaḥ kṣāmaḥ samīhanaḥ.

words.meaning: One who is never heedless, because He is ever self-fulfilled.
One of huge proportions, because He is in the form of cosmic person.
One without birth. Or one has no existence.

The sacrificial post for Dharmas, that is, one to whom all the forms of Dharma, which are His own form of worship, are attached, just as a sacrificial animal is attached to a Yupa or a sacrificial post.
One by offering sacrifices to whom, those sacrifices deserve to be called great, because they well give the fruit of Nirvana.
The heart of all nakshatras.
He is in the form of the nakshatra, Moon.
One who is clever in everything.
One who remains in the state of pure self after all the modifications of the mind have dwindled.
One who exerts well for creation, etc.

verses.devanagari: यज्ञ इज्यो महेज्यश्च क्रतुः सत्रं सतां गतिः । सर्वदर्शी विमुक्तात्मा सर्वज्ञो ज्ञानमुत्तमम् ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.iast: yajña ijyō mahejyaśca kratuḥ satraṁ satāṁ gatiḥ, sarvadarśī vimuktātmā sarvajñō jñānamuttamam.

words.meaning: One who is all-knowing.
One who is fit to be worshipped in sacrifices.
He who, of all deities worshipped, is alone capable of giving the blessing of liberation.
A Yajna in which there is a sacrificial post is Kratu.
One who is of the nature of ordained Dharma.
One who is the sole support for holy men who are seekers of Moksha.
One who by His inborn insight is able to see all good and evil actions of living beings.
One who is naturally free.
One who is all and also the knower of all.
That consciousness which is superior to all, birthless, unlimited by time and space and the cause of all achievements.

verses.devanagari: सुव्रतः सुमुखः सूक्ष्मः सुघोषः सुखदः सुहृत् । मनोहरो जितक्रोधो वीरबाहुर्विदारणः ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.iast: suvrataḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sughōṣaḥ sukhadaḥ suhṛt, manōharō jitakrōdhō vīrabāhurvidāraṇaḥ.

words.meaning: One who has take the magnanimous vow to save all refuge-seekers.
One with a pleasant face.
One who is subtle because He is without any gross causes like sound etc.
One whose auspicious sound is the Veda. Or one who has got a deep and sonorous sound like the clouds.
One who gives happiness to good people.
One who helps without looking for any return.
One who attracts the mind by His incomparable blissful nature.
One who has overcome anger.
One whose arms are capable of heroic deeds as demonstrated in his destruction of Asuras for establishing Vedic Dharma.
One who destroys those who live contrary to Dharma.

verses.devanagari: स्वापनः स्ववशो व्यापी नैकात्मा नैककर्मकृत् । वत्सरो वत्सलो वत्सी रत्नगर्भो धनेश्वरः ॥ ५० ॥
verses.iast: svāpanaḥ svavaśo vyāpī naikātmā naikakarmakṛt, vatsaro vatsalo vatsī ratnagarbho dhaneśvaraḥ.

words.meaning: One who enfolds the Jivas in the sleep of Ajnana.
One who is dominated by oneself and not anything else, as He is the cause of the whole cosmic process.
One who interpenetrates everything like Akasha.
One who manifests in different forms as the subsidiary agencies causing the various cosmic processes.
One who engages in innumerable activities in the process of creation, sustentation, etc.
One in whom everything dwells.
One who has love for His devotees.
One who protects those who are dear to Him.
